entities.name: 产品市场契合 (product market fit)
entities.how_described: 本集反复出现:上一个 AI 报税项目达到了某种 PMF 但不够成功;Town 几周做出的原型几乎立刻有 PMF;今天没有任何 AI 助手产品有真正深刻的 PMF。

evidence.quote: We got to some product market fit, but not enough where it was going to be a success.

evidence.quote: And the prototype, we built a quick prototype in a couple of weeks and it had product market fit almost immediately.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Step one is like, you need, we have to have really deep product market fit.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: And I think none of the products today actually have really deep product market fit yet.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So once you have product market fit with a user and they really love your experience and they've connected all the tools and all the connections, it's actually really hard for someone else to go in there
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: So then there's the macro question, which is, is all AI, you know, is there not real product market fit for AI products?
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

entities.name: 隐私 (privacy)
entities.how_described: 本集的隐私论:今天人类是信息流向的过滤器,五年内你会信任智能体替你决定分享什么;LLM 会非常擅长在你不想分享的事情上尊重隐私,信息隔离得越少 AI 干得越好。

evidence.quote: So one of them is just privacy and how your workplace is going to feel about their data being intermingled with your personal data.

evidence.quote: You might still have only one hardware entry point, but from a privacy perspective and from where your data lives, I think you're going to always want to separate on the data layer your personal and your work data.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: We have like lots of data controls and privacy and security and blah, blah, blah.
evidence.speaker: SPEAKER_01

evidence.quote: Is it a GDPR and privacy thing?

entities.name: 护栏 (guardrails)
entities.how_described: 本集谈安全时说:人类逐行读代码的世界回不去了,现在是计算机写代码上生产,配测试和护栏——友方模型先攻击你,免得不友好的模型以后找到可利用的漏洞。

evidence.quote: It's computers that are building code that is being shipped into production with various guardrails from testing to other models like friendly models attacking you so that unfriendly models can't later find exploitations.
